standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the separated case, the commuting left squares, and the properties (1)(2)(5) compatibilities.

core_obligations: Handle the separated sub-cases by the two earlier composition lemmas (proof lines 1891-1895).

Construct the general isomorphism: choose the covering Y = union Y_i with g_i separated, form the three-row diagram whose outer rows are exact by the colimit lemma and whose left squares commute by the separated case and locality of f_! on the base, and conclude the unique dotted arrow exists and is an isomorphism (proof lines 1898-1940).

Prove properties (1)-(5): (2) and then (1) from the compatibility of the separated-case maps, (5) from the corresponding compatibility under base change of the covering, (3) from the fibre-wise identification with the separated-case map after base change to a geometric point (the displayed square; the final commutativity check is the author's 'reader immediately sees', disclosed in the editorial note), and (4) on stalks using (3) (proof lines 1943-1968).
proof_roadmap: Reduce separated sub-cases and set up the open-covering construction diagram (proof lines 1891-1940).
Conclude the unique dotted isomorphism from exact rows and commuting squares (proof lines 1922-1940).
Verify properties (1)-(5), disclosing the two soft spots in the editorial note (proof lines 1943-1968).
